name: Traffic cameras (public DOT)
_comment: Public government traffic cameras as snapshot (img) or HLS feeds. For scale, prefer the runtime loader modules/dot-cameras.js (pulls hundreds of Caltrans cams live). Add other OFFICIAL open camera APIs here or via a module — each entry needs lat/lon and an img (JPEG snapshot URL) or hls (.m3u8). Only use sources published for public consumption.
